# tiny-AES-c

Upstream: https://github.com/kokke/tiny-AES-c

Pinned commit: `23856752fbd139da0b8ca6e471a13d5bcc99a08d`. The upstream source and Unlicense are retained unchanged. Only portable AES-128 block encryption/decryption is compiled; wiillr owns the hardware CBC and DMA state. Configuration macros and upstream context layout remain inside the implementation unit.
